name: Cloudflare

endpoints.summary: Check the token is valid and what it can do

params.name: purge_everything
params.description: true to purge the whole zone

params.name: files
params.description: Array of exact URLs to purge instead

docsDigest: Cloudflare API v4. Auth: Bearer API TOKEN (not the legacy Global API Key, which uses different headers and is not what this profile sends). Every response is wrapped as {"success": bool, "errors": [], "result": ...} - read `success`. Scope a token to the zones and permissions you need; a token verify call is the cheapest way to see what it can do.
notes: Keyless template. purge_cache is included because it is the one write people actually want; a token limited to Zone.Cache Purge cannot do anything else.
